retrievalProfile.description: A centered, heavy metallic winged emblem featuring a mix of chrome and gold finishes set against a dark, textured black leather background.
triggerTerms: heavy metal relief on black leather
excludeWhen: bright or colorful backgrounds are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, three-dimensional metallic emblem consisting of horizontal wings and a circular ring, rendered with high-contrast specular highlights and deep shadows to simulate polished chrome and brass, resting on a creased, matte black leather surface.
coreVisualRelationships: Metallic emblem centered on a dark organic texture
Chrome wings contrasting with a brass-toned circular ring
Hard-edged industrial geometry against soft, folded leather
Top-down lighting creating dramatic highlights on metal ridges
coreInvariants: Circular ring element behind the wings
Black leather background with visible grain and folds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The emblem is centrally positioned, occupying approximately 60% of the horizontal width and 40% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central vertical bar of the emblem acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central vertical element, moves outward along the horizontal wings, and then follows the circular ring.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black, textured leather fills the surrounding space, emphasizing the metallic subject.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm gold/brass (circular ring and central accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between specular highlights and deep shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif with industrial proportions
letterConstructionRules: Letters are embossed or debossed into the metal surface
Uniform stroke weight for secondary text
Central initial is significantly larger and vertically elongated
characterSpecificRedesigns: The central 'B' is integrated into the vertical spine of the emblem
Horizontal text is condensed to fit within the wing span
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary, smaller sans-serif follows the curve of the circular ring.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy, condensed industrial feel.
Best for replicating the 3D embossed metal effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution texture of a black leather motorcycle jacket with natural folds and soft top-down lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a 3D rendered metallic winged emblem in the center, using chrome for the wings and brass for the circular ring, with embossed block lettering.

verificationChecks: Does the metal have realistic specular highlights?
Is the leather texture visible in the dark areas?
Is the lettering integrated as a 3D relief?

mustRedesign: Exact alphanumeric sequences from the source
postGenerationChecks: Ensure leather folds look natural and not procedural
Verify that the text is legible despite the 3D effects
Confirm the central 'B' element is the primary vertical anchor
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Metallic Emblem [Subject] + Black Leather Jacket [Background] + Industrial 3D Typography [Style]
